# Double EMA

*Double EMA: 2 x EMA minus EMA of EMA, less lag.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Double EMA** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `9` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#43A047"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/dema.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Double EMA", shortTitle: "DEMA", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 9, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const e1 = ta.ema(src, length), e2 = ta.ema(e1, length);
plot(ta.calc([e1, e2], (a, b) => 2 * a - b), { title: "DEMA", color: input.color("Color", "#43A047", { group: "Style" }) });
```
